## Appearance

Stacy has fair, curly hair. Her eyes are also described as fascinating.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Stacy is a bright and sympathetic young woman. She possesses a natural ability to easily win and maintain the affection of her pupils.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## History

Miss Stacy became the new schoolteacher, under whose guidance [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) thrived as she returned to school in October. As the end of the school term approached, Miss Stacy delighted her students by confirming that she would return to teach the Queen's class the following year.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as Anne's new schoolteacher, acting as an inspiring mentor whom [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) thrives under and holds in high regard. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enthusiastically shares her school experiences and concert roles with her guardians because of Miss Stacy's influence, and she delights in learning that Miss Stacy will return to teach the Queen's preparation class. Their strong bond as teacher and helpful friend continues as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully passes her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations under Miss Stacy's guidance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P0](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV.
